Package io.github.kimbongjune.geoserverclient.api.datastore

Class DataStoreManager

java.lang.Object
io.github.kimbongjune.geoserverclient.api.AbstractManager
io.github.kimbongjune.geoserverclient.api.datastore.DataStoreManager
public class DataStoreManager extends AbstractManager
GeoServer DataStore REST API manager.

A DataStore is a container for vector spatial data. Supported sources include files (Shapefile), databases (PostGIS), and remote servers (WFS). Each DataStore belongs to a specific workspace and can hold one or more FeatureTypes.

Endpoints

 GET     /rest/workspaces/{workspaceName}/datastores
 POST    /rest/workspaces/{workspaceName}/datastores
 GET     /rest/workspaces/{workspaceName}/datastores/{storeName}
 PUT     /rest/workspaces/{workspaceName}/datastores/{storeName}
 DELETE  /rest/workspaces/{workspaceName}/datastores/{storeName}
 PUT     /rest/workspaces/{workspaceName}/datastores/{storeName}/reset
 POST    /rest/workspaces/{workspaceName}/datastores/{storeName}/reset
 GET     /rest/workspaces/{workspaceName}/datastores/{storeName}/{method}.{format}
 PUT     /rest/workspaces/{workspaceName}/datastores/{storeName}/{method}.{format}
 POST    /rest/workspaces/{workspaceName}/datastores/{storeName}/mosaic/{method}.{format}
 POST    /workspaces/{ws}/appschemastores/{store}/cleanSchemas
 POST    /workspaces/{ws}/appschemastores/{store}/datastores/{id}/cleanSchemas
 POST    /workspaces/{ws}/appschemastores/{store}/rebuildMongoSchemas?ids=...&max=N
 POST    /workspaces/{ws}/appschemastores/{store}/datastores/{id}/rebuildMongoSchemas?ids=...&max=N&schema=...

      public DataStore create(String workspaceName, CreateDataStoreRequest request)
      Create a new DataStore.

      workspaceName - workspace name (required)

      public DataStore update(String workspaceName, String storeName, UpdateDataStoreRequest request)
      Update a DataStore. Partial update supported.

      Note: including connectionParameters replaces all existing parameters entirely.

      Parameters:
      workspaceName - workspace name (required)
      storeName - current DataStore name to update (required)
      request - update parameters (required)
      Returns:
      the updated DataStore (fetched via GET after PUT)
      Throws:
      InvalidParameterException - if workspaceName/storeName/request is null/empty
      DataStoreNotFoundException - if no DataStore with the given name exists

    • delete

      public void delete(String workspaceName, String storeName, boolean recurse)
      Delete a DataStore with purge=none.
      Parameters:
      workspaceName - workspace name (required)
      storeName - DataStore name to delete (required)
      recurse - when true, also deletes all FeatureTypes and Layers in the store; when false, the store must be empty or 403 is returned

    • delete

      public void delete(String workspaceName, String storeName, boolean recurse, String purge)
      Delete a DataStore with explicit recurse and purge options.
      Parameters:
      workspaceName - workspace name (required)
      storeName - DataStore name to delete (required)
      recurse - when true, also deletes child FeatureTypes/Layers
      purge - source file deletion policy: "none" (default, keep files), "metadata" (delete metadata only), "all" (delete all files)
      Throws:
      InvalidParameterException - if workspaceName or storeName is null/empty
      DataStoreNotFoundException - if no DataStore with the given name exists (404)

    • reset

      public void reset(String workspaceName, String storeName)
      Reset the DataStore cache. Forces GeoServer to reconnect to the source on the next request. PUT and POST behave identically; implemented as PUT. Verified against GeoServer 2.28.2.
      Parameters:
      workspaceName - workspace name (required)
      storeName - DataStore name to reset (required)
      Throws:
      InvalidParameterException - if workspaceName or storeName is null/empty

    • uploadFile

      public void uploadFile(String workspaceName, String storeName, String method, String format, File file)
      Create or update a DataStore by uploading a file. 
       // Shapefile ZIP upload example
 manager.uploadFile("sf", "mystore", "file", "shp", zipFile)

 // GeoPackage upload example
 manager.uploadFile("sf", "mygpkg", "file", "gpkg", gpkgFile)
      Parameters:
      workspaceName - workspace name (required)
      storeName - DataStore name (required)
      method - upload method: "file" (local upload), "url" (remote URL), "external" (existing server file)
      format - file format: "shp", "properties", "h2", "gpkg", "mbtiles", "geoparquet"
      file - file to upload (ZIP must have flat structure for Shapefiles)
      Throws:
      InvalidParameterException - if any required parameter is null/empty

    • uploadFile

      public void uploadFile(String workspaceName, String storeName, String method, String format, File file, String configure, String update, String charset)
      Create or update a DataStore by uploading a file (with optional parameters).
      Parameters:
      workspaceName - workspace name (required)
      storeName - DataStore name (required)
      method - "file", "url", "external"
      format - "shp", "properties", "h2", "gpkg", "mbtiles", "geoparquet"
      file - file to upload
      configure - FeatureType auto-configuration: "first" (default), "none", "all"
      update - data update policy: "append" (default), "overwrite"
      charset - file encoding (e.g. "UTF-8", "EUC-KR")

    • downloadFile

      public byte[] downloadFile(String workspaceName, String storeName, String method, String format)
      Download the DataStore source files as a ZIP archive.

      Only works for file-based stores (Shapefile, GeoPackage, etc.) when the actual files are accessible in the GeoServer data directory. DB-based stores (H2, PostGIS) return 404 as they have no file path.

      Parameters:
      workspaceName - workspace name (required)
      storeName - DataStore name (required)
      method - access method: "file", "url", "external"
      format - file format: "shp", "gpkg", etc.
      Returns:
      ZIP file bytes
      Throws:
      DataStoreNotFoundException - if the store does not exist or has no server-side files (404)
